name: EdgeDB v0.5 2026 OOS evaluation (Turn 3)

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/edgedb_v05_2026_oos_eval_pr.yml'
      - 'horse-racing/jrdb/src/jrdb_edge_v05_2026_oos_eval.py'
      - 'horse-racing/jrdb/tests/test_jrdb_edge_v05_2026_oos_eval.py'
      - 'horse-racing/jrdb/config/edgedb/v0_5/frozen/v05_positive_value_frozen_cohort.json'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  oos-eval:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install runtime
        run: python -m pip install -r tools/data-storage/requirements.txt
      - name: Download immutable Turn 2 match freeze
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/turn2
          gh run download 37612817025 --repo yukki0113/GPT             --name edgedb-v05-2026-match-freeze-pr-1897 --dir /tmp/turn2
          test -f /tmp/turn2/v05_2026_match_freeze.parquet
      - name: Download canonical 2026 SED history
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/sed2026
          gh run download 37604723913 --repo yukki0113/GPT             --name jrdb-daily-history-20260101-20261007 --dir /tmp/sed2026
      - name: Run focused tests
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: horse-racing/jrdb/src
        run: python -m unittest horse-racing/jrdb/tests/test_jrdb_edge_v05_2026_oos_eval.py -v
      - name: Run Turn 3 OOS evaluation
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: horse-racing/jrdb/src
        run: |
          python horse-racing/jrdb/src/jrdb_edge_v05_2026_oos_eval.py             --cohort horse-racing/jrdb/config/edgedb/v0_5/frozen/v05_positive_value_frozen_cohort.json             --match /tmp/turn2/v05_2026_match_freeze.parquet             --sed-root /tmp/sed2026             --output-root /tmp/v05-turn3
      - name: Upload Turn 3 artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: edgedb-v05-2026-oos-eval-pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || 'manual' }}
          path: /tmp/v05-turn3/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
          compression-level: 0
